title: Zesty Middle Eastern Eggplant Pie
description: A buttery, glassy-jelly eggplant pie that blends tangy yogurt sauce with aromatic spices, baked in ready‑rolled shortcrust pastry for a comforting keto-friendly dinner.
instructions: Fill a sous‑vide water bath to 65°C and place the eggplant slices in a vacuum‑sealed bag; cook for 30 minutes, then remove and pat dry.
In a bowl whisk the yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, zest, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt and pepper until smooth.
Lay the pastry sheet on a lightly greased baking sheet, trim excess edges, and pre‑bake for 5 minutes to set the base.
Remove the pastry, spread a thin layer of the yogurt sauce, arrange a layer of eggplant, repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce on top.
Fold the pastry edges over the top layer and crimp to seal.
Bake the assembled pie for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden and the sauce has set into a glassy‑jelly consistency.
Let the pie rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve warm.
